protocol: Mechanism check on the 23 original disputed states, separate from and unable to change the frozen revision. Cross binary stop/continue vs native available tool menu/finish, full stop context vs original observed-only context, original seed routing instruction vs bounded stop skill plus memory, and text only vs actual image. Hold other prompt components constant within each contrast. Record semantic stops and exact reproduction of the native base action. The action-presentation intervention changes both the prompt choices and available next-token set. This is an inference behavior check, not score-based selection.
